answer: A single treasurer can mint a flock of look-alike voters and rent congress weight for almost nothing. Each identity must moor a 44 POA keel in a harbor berth for 13 epochs, then walk a 7-switchback canyon trail, leaving cairns at least 9 minutes apart. A second clone needs its own berth and a disjoint trail. At the nadir of the trail a one-shot beacon must be signed within 40s. Peers replay the keel lock, check cairn spacing, and reject a reused berth ID. A missed nadir beacon or two trails that share a cairn burns 58% of the keel; a harbor clerk who double-assigns a berth loses 11 POA.
